environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in a VPC with public subnet. The SQS queue has a permissive access policy allowing any authenticated AWS principal to send messages. The origin S3 bucket has a public bucket policy allowing GetObject from any source IP. No CloudFront distribution is configured; the consumer fetches directly from the S3 bucket's public HTTP endpoint. The consumer's task role has sqs:ReceiveMessage, sqs:DeleteMessage permissions and unrestricted outbound network access.
